entry.title: Bounds on chain length with BIP-54 timewarp fixes
entry.summary:
A recent update has been made to the post, incorporating the $w$-bound accurate formula. This enhancement ensures that readers have access to a more precise mathematical expression relevant to the subject matter.
Validation of this new formula is supported by an accompanying proof, which is available in the associated Lean code. The integration of formal verification through Lean substantiates the reliability and correctness of the formula, reinforcing its mathematical soundness.
Additionally, the decimal approximation formula has been included in the update. This offers a practical computational tool for those who require approximate values rather than symbolic results. For further reference and to explore the formal proof, readers are encouraged to consult the linked Lean code.
